digest.component_or_area: CLI command structure and bridge subsystem
propositions: Three CLI verbs are renamed to nest under a bridge noun: `bridge-fsck` → `bridge fsck`, `bridge-probe` → `bridge check-access`, `jira-onboard` → `bridge setup`
Old verb spellings remain as functional compatibility entrypoints that delegate to identical implementations without behavior divergence
New spellings become canonical in help text, documentation, and automated workflows; old spellings are hidden but executable
`bridge setup` passes through remainder arguments to the onboarding wizard and calls `bridge check-access` for final validation with env overlay
All in-tree consumers including CLI dispatch, tests, scripts, workflows, and documentation must migrate to new spellings in one atomic change
Repository-wide stale-vocabulary test validates that only explicitly-allowed compatibility registrations retain old spellings
